correctness.rationale: Finite exhaustive proof over 13 points/lines and full order-5616 PGL3(3), rank-six evaluation kernel, complete 3^9 quartic system, projective stabilizer orbit decomposition, and exact unit-ideal Gröbner criterion over algebraic closure on each affine chart. A self-contained checker ran and returned 234 sets, 567 exact-point-set quartics, 222 smooth with ten orbits, and 51948 globally. Canonical plane quartic embedding identifies F3-isomorphism with PGL3(3). Limit: computational proof depends on exact finite-field algebra implementation, not outside independent certification.

value.rationale: Complete realization/isomorphism classification at a distinguished Blokhuis-sharp nontrivial blocking set, connecting a natural finite-geometric extremal condition to smooth canonical genus-three curves. Precise ten classes and one symmetric order-four exception are not derivable from the known set-size bound or general point-count tables. Finite scope natural and exact, not a routine substitute, arbitrary sliced parameter space, or unsupported general theorem.
